ns2:section.sectionText: A prerequisite of BADM 350 will be enforced. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, November 17, 2014 and to ISE students and Informatics Minors on Monday, December 1, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 6 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 23, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor admitted prior to January 2013.
